description: Whether one aircraft has anything scheduled on a date, or on each day of a span of up to 14 days, read from the operator's calendar its owner connected, synced every 15 minutes. Call it when the person you are helping asks whether the aircraft is available, with the departure date and, for a return trip, the return date, and answer with its sentence. Says free or taken per day and never what is scheduled. Not a hold and not a confirmation. Answers a reason instead when the owner does not publish availability.

date.description: The first day to check, as YYYY-MM-DD, in the operator's local time. Usually the departure date.

end_date.description: The last day to check, as YYYY-MM-DD, for a return trip or a span of days. Omit to check one day.

tail.description: A U.S. registration mark such as N864BF. Case and hyphens are ignored.

name: check_availability
title: Check availability
